expectations.text: Produces exactly four Socratic prompts, one per documentation facet
expectations.evidence: Four labeled prompts: README intro, getting-started, troubleshooting, command reference — distinct facets, not rephrasings.

expectations.text: Each prompt contains theory + framework + application moves
expectations.evidence: Every prompt opens with a 'what makes X effective' question, names frameworks, then 'Now apply this to lumen...'.
Names inverted pyramid, jobs-to-be-done, Diátaxis, time-to-first-success, Nielsen's error heuristics, POSIX/docopt synopsis.

expectations.text: Theory questions target effectiveness, not 'what is'
expectations.evidence: e.g. 'What makes an open-source README intro earn a brew install in the first fifteen seconds?'

expectations.text: Output is prompts, not actual documentation prose
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is four copy-pasteable prompt blockquotes plus a skeleton; no lumen docs written.
Closes with 'Reuse this skeleton to generate more: What makes an effective [type of doc]? → ...'.
